As the start of the next business day is approaching, I wanted to check on the current status of these items and confirm whether everything is on track for timely provisioning. Having these resources in place before business hours begin is essential for me to be fully operational.

Could you kindly provide a brief update at your earliest convenience? Please let me know if there is any additional information you need from my end to expedite the process.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Sarah
